reply_text:
I told Marcus in a reply to his #north-team message that the next renewal for Brackenwater Freight Co. is **25 November**.

- **Where it came from:** Ilse Varga posted that date in #north-team on 14 October. Marcus is a member of that channel, so he can see it himself. Nothing posted there since has changed it.
- **What I couldn't check:** gbrain refused the search, saying its connection isn't linked to a specific member, so it returned nothing. Fixing that needs someone running the gbrain command-line tool on the server that hosts it, so I didn't try. I also didn't check account files or other records, so the date comes only from Ilse's channel post.
